sources.title: Comparative Analysis of Distributed Caching Algorithms: Performance ...
sources.snippet: Our comparative analysis reveals that while traditional al- algorithms like LRU and LFU continue to serve as founda- tional approaches in distributed caching, hybrid and adaptive algorithms demonstrate superior performance across diverse workload patterns.
